JUST FOR FUN · OPTIONAL
Real intelligence work is mostly listening to the same tape twice. Elena, Tomasz, and Ingrid have one reel recorded in a Vienna rehearsal hall, and a sealed file that tells them exactly what to listen for: tempo, dynamics, and timbre. The file never says whether the recording is good. It only hands them the three things to judge it by, which is how musicians have graded their own playing for two hundred years.
If you recorded yourself playing or singing, which would you check first: how fast it was, how loud it was, or what it sounded like?
